title: Disc-flip
tagline: Press it. Hop it. Pot it.
description: The English parlour game with a felt mat and a cup. Press a big disc on a small one to hop it into the cup or onto a rival's, with the odds shown as you aim.
howToPlay: Press near one of your winks, then choose a squidger: Potter, Squidger or Bomber.
Pull back like a catapult and let go; the dashed oval is where it may land.
Let go as the steadiness ring meets the gold mark for a tighter landing.
Drop a wink in the cup to score and shoot again.
Land on a rival wink to freeze it; the Bomber blasts a pile apart.
